description: Header file defining platform-specific interface functions for health monitoring of the fsmonitor daemon; contains function declarations for initialization, cleanup, event loop, and asynchronous stopping of the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor health thread; returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

methods.name: fsm_health__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__loop
methods.description: Runs the platform-specific event loop to monitor daemon health status; sets error code to -1 on failure.

methods.name: fsm_health__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the health thread to shutdown asynchronously without waiting for its completion.
